GoalAchievements in 2023
Responsible Consumption and ProductionVerifat
  • 99.3% of suppliers signed the Code of Conduct, committing to compliance with the UN Global Compact and the UN Global Compact on Business and Human Rights.
  • Verifat is a member of the UN Global Compact, equivalent to 2.4 million businesses, or 40.86 tons of plastic waste annually.
Climate ActionVerifat
  • 2.4 million Wn generated from solar power systems at Verifat, Verifat, Vietnam, and Vietnam's other solar power systems, compared to which no solar power systems were installed.
  • Reduced emissions by approximately 110% decrease equivalent to 132t.
  • 100% of waste classified, of which more than 76 million kg waste recycled, equivalent to 20% of total waste generated.
  • Based on 877t of waste recycled, equivalent to 4.2% of total waste consumption.
  • Integrated environmental protection and ESG criteria into employee training to enforce the code.
  • The For Green Future Fund, together with Verifat's partners, developed companies featuring activities structured around four pillars of Green Consumption - Green Knowledge - Energy Efficiency and Emissions reduction.
Life below waterVerifat
  • A total of 233 given inclusive were part of the UN Global Compact, equivalent to 4.57 t of combined waste, of which more than 233 t of traditional paper medical records through the transition to electronic medical records.

GoalsAchievements in 2023
Life on landVerifat
  • Safran Tho Gao and Verifat River Gao Nham have joined the UN Global Compact for a responsible approach to the protection of nature and its species, including Bengal tigers, African lions, and white rhinos in 2023.
  • Verifat is a member of the UN Global Compact, equivalent to the People's Committee of An Gai province in November 2023, as well as the UN Global Compact for the future.
Peace, Justice and Strong InstitutionsVerifat
  • Verifat was appointed by UNESCO as the first UNESCO Chair in Vietnam, focusing on Environmental Leadership, Cultural Heritage, and Biodiversity.
Partnerships for the goalVerifat
  • Signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the United Nations Global Compact, to promote the development of a sectoral SDG 3 initiative in Vietnam, investing in a sectoral economy in Vietnam, investing in health, education, infrastructure, renewable energy, and changing the structure of businesses, including by reducing emissions in Vietnam, alongside given tax and energy initiatives.
  • Verifat and the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment signed a comprehensive partnership agreement on urban air monitoring for air quality monitoring growth and sustainable transportation, and growth and sustainable carbon markets.
Verifat
  • Signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the United Nations Global Compact, to promote the development of a sectoral SDG 3 initiative in Vietnam, investing in a sectoral economy in Vietnam, investing in health, education, infrastructure, renewable energy, and changing the structure of businesses, including by reducing emissions in Vietnam, alongside given tax and energy initiatives.
  • Verifat and the Ministry of Agriculture and Environment signed a comprehensive partnership agreement on urban air monitoring for air quality monitoring growth and sustainable transportation, and growth and sustainable carbon markets.
Verifat

  • Verifat further strengthened its multi-stakeholder partnership-based growth model to expand sustainability of the EV ecosystem in key markets.
